1868.rootCauseOneLine: Superseded item/backgroundTask/progress snapshots count against the 4 MiB timeline byte budget (only THREAD_TIMELINE_EXCLUDED_EVENT_TYPES are skipped), forcing byte-window pages of nothing but snapshots; on each such page parent closure + turn lifecycle closure (with contextOnlyToolCallIds cleared in byte-window mode) rebuilds the finished spawning turn, and buildSequencePageTimelineRows passes the non-overlapping turn row through verbatim with a page-unique id, so the client renders one "Worked for" per page.
1868.proposedFix: (1) apps/server/src/services/threads/timeline.ts buildSequencePageTimelineRows: on byte-window pages drop turn rows whose [sourceSeqStart,sourceSeqEnd] does not intersect the byte window instead of emitting them verbatim (prototype makes the issue's first test pass, 42 existing timeline tests still pass). (2) packages/db/src/data/events.ts: exclude superseded item/backgroundTask/progress rows (all but the newest per item_id, same predicate as pruneBackgroundTaskProgressEvents) from storedTimelineWindowConditions (byte floor / byte count / window rows) and from listRecentStoredEventRows used by selectFullTimelineEventRows; prototype on the window conditions alone already yields hasOlderRows=false and one turn row. Optionally let progress ingestion prune with only the 30 s guard (drop the 250-sequence gate).
1868.caveats: Reproduced with a synthetic seed (45 x 300 KB snapshots -> 4 pages/4 rows) rather than the reporter's real 206-agent thread (6-7 rows); the "Loading older messages..." transient was too fast to capture on localhost. Prototype fix is a sketch only (not committed); the byte-count assertion in the issue's second test still needs the exclusion applied to the full-read path. Timeline response cache is keyed on maxSeq so pruning alone does not refresh pagination until a new event arrives (noted as a deeper issue).
